_comment: Right-click context help. Transcribed from EVANHELP::_main_screen_help_list (evanhelp.cpp:4), installed by EVANHELP::Set_Main_Screen_Help_List_ (evanhelp.cpp:229). Only the 15 STATIC entries are here; the same function appends more at runtime for the multiplayer bar and the fleet popup, and neither exists in HD yet. Note what is NOT in the original's list: the map area itself. A right click on the stars means nothing to MOO2, which is why OrionLayer is free to pan with it.
_omitted: Help 300 (the ZOOM rocker, native 236,425-307,479) has no HD element: fields 8/9 no longer drive the view and there is no rocker cutout in frame.png. Add the region here the day the rocker is drawn.
_pad_y: The original's sidebar rectangles cover the whole row band: 45-119 inside a pitch of 76, then a gap of exactly 2 native pixels to the next entry, four times over (evanhelp.cpp:4). The HD sb_* boxes are sized to their content, 93 reference pixels inside a pitch of 109/110, which left a dead 16-pixel strip between readouts where a right click opened nothing. pad_y grows each region by 7 reference pixels top and bottom, chosen because it is the largest value that keeps the band inside the `sidebar` cutout (111-767): the outer rows then reach 112 and 766, and the gaps between rows come out at 2-3, against the original's 2. Coverage 107 of 109 where the original has 74 of 76. The pad is NOT applied to the boxes themselves - the readouts must keep drawing where they were tuned to draw.
hd_extension: The help popup auto-sizes to its text and scrolls when it cannot fit. The original draws a fixed box and lets FMTPARA wrap into it at a fixed 339 px (TEXTBOX::Draw_Help_Entry_, textbox.cpp:307); at four HD resolutions a fixed box either wastes half the screen on two lines or clips a long entry. The deviation belongs to the panel rather than to any one region, so it is marked once per file, at the top level. Also marked in core/helppopup.py and asserted by the smoke test.

regions.hd_extension: The original's stardate rectangle is a 17-pixel strip inside a 21-pixel row (native 24-41, treasury starts at 45) — it is the only sidebar entry that does not fill its row. HD covers the full 107-pixel band like the five readouts. The deviation is not the pad: sb_stardate_text is already 93 reference pixels tall, the same as every other row, because the HD sidebar gives the stardate a row rather than a strip. Holding the original's proportions here would mean scaling the region back to about 28 pixels and leaving 80 pixels of dead column between the stardate and the treasury — exactly the fault this pad removes, and with nothing else in that band to click. Marked because it is a deliberate deviation, not a transcription.
